caption:
Mif yoki fakt? 🟢

Telegram NFT sovg‘asini profilingizda ko‘rsatish uchun uni sotib olish shart emas. Ijaraga oling: gift 3 kundan 30 kungacha profilingizda ko‘rinib turadi. Kuniga 750 so‘m, 30 kunga −7%.

Liberty Figure #188694: Peridot modeli 3%, Amber fon 1,2%, Corn belgisi 0,5%.

Yana qaysi mifni eshitgansiz? Izohda yozing.

Ijaraga olish: @ArendagaGiftBot — havola profilda.

#telegram #nft #telegramgifts #nftsovga #ijara #uzbekistan

concept.title: Mif yoki fakt
concept.hook: Birinchi kadr — to‘q o‘rmon-yashil sahna, prozhektor ostida katta yashil kristall Liberty Figure; tepada "Telegram NFT sovg‘a ijarasi / Kuniga 750 so‘m"; 0,3 s da narx yoniga yashil "FAKT ✓" muhri uriladi, sahna silkinadi, gift sakraydi va kristall uchqunlar sochiladi
concept.format: Mif va fakt (yangi): ikki mif marjon-qizil "MIF ✕" muhri bilan chiziladi, har biriga yashil "FAKT ✓" javob beradi — "Sotib olish shart" → "Ijara: 3–30 kun"; "Ijaradagi gift ko‘rinmaydi" → "Profilingizda turadi"; yakunda narx + bot + havola
concept.why: Statistika (100–220 ko‘rish, o‘tkazib yuborish 47–84%) kreativ sabablarni ajratib bermaydi, shuning uchun doimiy qoidalar qo‘llandi: 0-kadrda mahsulot va narx aniq, katta gift, 0,3 s da giftga nimadir bo‘ladi, o‘qish uchun qulay temp. Mif/fakt formati ijara haqidagi ikki asosiy shubhaga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri javob beradi.
concept.differs: Format (mif va fakt muhrlari — yangi), ko‘rinish (to‘q o‘rmon-yashil sahna, prozhektor, kristall parchalar, rezina muhrlar — yangi), palitra (yashil + marjon-qizil + krem; oldingi firuza-magenta, oltin-zumrad, binafsha-laymdan farqli), shrift (Big Shoulders Stencil — 18e dan beri, Bricolage Grotesque — 17b dan beri), gift (Liberty Figure — birinchi marta), musiqa (calm, B♭-major, 76 bpm, seed 229), yangi tovush inkstamp.wav
